newsitem.title: USA: Roper sees FY96 EPS in $1.86-$1.88 range.
newsitem.headline: Roper sees FY96 EPS in $1.86-$1.88 range.

text.p: Roper Industries Inc said on Tuesday it expected its earnings per share for the fiscal year ended October 31 to fall in the range of $1.86 to $1.88 per share.
The company said it estimated revenue of between $225 million and $226 million for the fiscal year.
The preliminary estimates compare with earnings of $1.54 per share and revenues of $175.4 million the previous year.
Roper said the increase reflected contributions of several acquisitions and improved results from most of its operating companies.
